_comment: The view contract, read by visualizer.js's registry and by tools/validate.py. Adding a view means adding views/<name>.js and one entry here — no other JavaScript and no validator changes.

cells.description: One labelled box per element. Arrays and strings where the VALUES matter.

bars.description: Columns at true height. Histograms and elevation maps where the SHAPE matters.

stack.description: Input on a row with the stack growing beneath it. For problems where the answer depends on what you kept.
